description:
Compile a deterministic, cited disclosure draft from supplied company
    facts and an optional verified GHG-ledger result. Missing required
    datapoints remain explicit gaps; no prose or values are fabricated.
    Frameworks: esrs-e1, ifrs-s2, sec-climate, tnfd, ca-sb253 (California
    SB 253 first-cycle Scope 1 and 2); list_frameworks gives the current set.
    If a call fails, the response includes first_call_help.
    Example arguments: {"framework": "esrs-e1", "company_facts": {"company_name": "Acme Climate Works", "reporting_period": "2026", "transition_plan": {"status": "board-approved", "target_year": 2035}, "climate_targets": {"scope": "Scopes 1-3", "target": "50% by 2035"}, "ghg_intensity": {"value": "0.012", "unit": "tCO2e/USDm revenue"}}, "options": {"applicability": {"framework": "esrs-e1", "applies": true, "reason": "company is in CSRD scope"}}}

company_facts.description: Facts about the company, as an object. Only supplied facts are used; anything missing is listed as a gap. Keys read, by framework: ca-sb253: assurance_status, company_name, ghg_methodology, organizational_boundary, reporting_period; esrs-e1: climate_targets, company_name, ghg_intensity, reporting_period, transition_plan; ifrs-s2: climate_governance, climate_resilience, climate_strategy, climate_targets, company_name, reporting_period, risk_management_process; sec-climate: board_oversight, climate_targets, company_name, management_role, material_climate_risks, reporting_period, risk_management_process; tnfd: company_name, leap_process, nature_dependencies_and_impacts, nature_governance, nature_metrics, nature_risks_and_opportunities, nature_targets, priority_locations, reporting_period.
company_facts.title: Company Facts

framework.description: Which disclosure to draft. One of: ca-sb253, esrs-e1, ifrs-s2, sec-climate, tnfd.
framework.title: Framework

ghg_result.description: Optional. The `data` object of a ghg-ledger calculate_inventory result, passed unchanged; it fills the emission datapoints and is verified before use.
ghg_result.title: Ghg Result

options.description: Must hold `applicability`: {framework: the same framework id, applies: true, reason: why it applies to this company}.
options.title: Options

payment_ref.description: Optional. A paid credit or payment reference, used only after the free daily calls. Leave it out to use the free tier or a seat.
payment_ref.title: Payment Ref

request_id.description: Optional. Your id for this call. Repeat it to retry safely: the same request_id is never charged twice.
request_id.title: Request Id

name: compile_disclosure
title: Compile sustainability disclosure
